data.title: Detienen a madre tras difundirse video de presunto maltrato a su hija de 13 años
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. - Por suponerla responsable del delito de maltrato familiar agravado en perjuicio de una menor de edad, agentes de la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones (DPI) capturaron a una mujer de 36 años. Los agentes asignados al Departamento de Delitos Especiales lograron la detención de la mujer mediante un auto motivado de detención preventiva en la colonia 14 de Enero, en Comayagüela. La detención se ejecutó como resultado de las diligencias investigativas realizadas por agentes de la DPI, luego de que se viralizara en redes sociales un video en el que presuntamente se observa a la mujer castigar a la menor. La sospechosa fue localizada y detenida en cumplimiento de un auto motivado de detención preventiva emitido por la Fiscalía Especial de Protección a la Niñez y Adolescencia (FEPN). De acuerdo con las investigaciones, la menor habría sido víctima de reiteradas agresiones físicas y verbales dentro de su entorno familiar. Según las diligencias realizadas por los equipos de investigación, la presunta agresora habría golpeado a la víctima y, en una de las ocasiones, la habría atado de pies y manos, colocado un objeto en su boca y cubierto su rostro con cinta adhesiva. Además, presuntamente le habría propinado golpes con una manguera que le provocaron lesiones y moretones en diferentes partes del cuerpo. Las investigaciones señalan que la menor habría sido objeto de amenazas, insultos y otras agresiones físicas presuntamente cometidas por la ahora detenida. Los hechos fueron documentados por los agentes investigadores, quienes desarrollaron las diligencias correspondientes para establecer la responsabilidad de la sospechosa y brindar protección a la víctima. La mujer fue puesta a disposición de las autoridades competentes para continuar con el procedimiento legal correspondiente, conforme a lo establecido en la legislación, por el delito de maltrato familiar.

data.title: Emely Alemán deslumbra en Tailandia con el traje de "El Cadejo" para Honduras
data.description: Tailandia.- La bella representante hondureña en el Miss Grand Internacional 2026 , Emely Alemán , desfiló este miércoles 7 de octubre en la categoría National Costume del certamen, luciendo un traje inspirado en " El Cadejo ", una leyenda que se ha contado por generaciones en Honduras. La propuesta denominada "El cadejo negro, espíritu que cambia de formas", causó sensación y la ovación del público, según se aprecia en el video compartido en la cuenta oficial de Emely. En las imágenes se aprecia el imponente traje de la concursante hondureña. Emely se apareció frente al público mostrando el rostro de una criatura negra de ojos rojos, y una figura cubierta por una capa negra satinada. Mientras avanzaba en la pasarela, la concursante dejó caer la primera capa de su traje, dándole paso a la versión oculta, donde se aprecia que la corona de Emely pasó a ser una lechuza con grandes ojos y pico dorado. Debajo, un corpiño con bordados dorados, cuentas y piedras de colores se completa con un cuello ornamentado y alas de plumas blancas y anaranjadas que se extienden a los costados. De acuerdo con la descripción oficial, la propuesta de la hondureña representa la sabiduría, vigilancia y conexión con lo invisible. "Más que una creación de vestuario, El Cadejo es una interpretación artística de nuestras raíces y un homenaje a la riqueza cultural que identifica a Honduras. Nuestra historia también merece ser contada al mundo", escribieron en la página oficial de Emely, adjunto al video de su desfile. El desfile se dio en un momento clave para la hondureña, quien entró en la etapa decisiva del certamen con la mirada puesta en la competencia preliminar de este miércoles. La gala preliminar comenzó a las 08:00 en el MGI Hall, en Bangkok, con un desfile de las candidatas en traje de baño, en el que la hondureña también destacó por su esbelta figura y dominio de la pasarela. Todas las concursantes lucieron el mismo modelo de bikini y tuvieron alrededor de 10 segundos para mostrarse ante el público, al ritmo de la canción "Hottie Frutti", del grupo Katseye. Mientras avanza esta etapa del certamen, la hondureña sigue dejando su huella en Tailandia con su impecable participación en representación del país. La gran final del Miss Grand International 2026 se realizará el próximo sábado 10 de octubre de 2026 en Ecuador.

data.title: Nueva York declara emergencia por el peor brote de sarampión desde 1991 en EE UU
data.description: Nueva York.- Nueva York declaró una emergencia estatal por el aumento de casos de sarampión , mientras que el estado de Pensilvania superó los 1.000 contagios este 2026, en un repunte que ha llevado a EE UU a registrar su peor año de sarampión desde 1991. La gobernadora de Nueva York, Kathy Hochul, emitió una orden ejecutiva que amplía el grupo de profesionales autorizados a administrar vacunas contra el sarampión e incluye entre ellos a paramédicos, personal de emergencias médicas avanzadas, farmacéuticos y matronas. La orden también permite a los profesionales sanitarios solicitar pruebas para detectar la enfermedad. "Nadie debería enfermar gravemente ni morir a causa de una enfermedad prevenible mediante vacunación. Por eso he tomado medidas para aumentar el número de profesionales de la salud que pueden vacunar y realizar pruebas. Estas medidas de emergencia protegerán a los neoyorquinos", dijo Hochul en un comunicado. Según el Departamento de Salud de Nueva York, hasta el 3 de octubre se confirmaron 108 casos en el estado este año, siete de ellos en la ciudad de Nueva York y 101 en el resto del estado. En el comunicado, el senador estatal Gustavo Rivera destacó que "el preocupante aumento de casos de sarampión se debe a una disminución en la vacunación infantil, impulsada por la desinformación, y está provocando una emergencia de salud pública". Por su parte, en Pensilvania, las autoridades informaron este lunes de que ya se han registrado 1.004 casos desde que comenzó su brote el pasado abril al oeste de Filadelfia, la ciudad más grande de ese estado. De estos casos, 198 personas han sido hospitalizadas y cinco han muerto. En total, Estados Unidos ha registrado casi 3.900 casos de sarampión este año, según los Centros para el Control y la Prevención de Enfermedades (CDC), en el que es su peor registro desde 1991. Desde comienzos de 2025 se han producido grandes brotes en varios estados del país, entre ellos Texas, Utah y Carolina del Sur, que llegó a registrar 997 casos. Según el CDC, Estados Unidos declaró eliminado el sarampión en el 2000 gracias a los altos niveles de vacunación, pero la cobertura entre los niños ha caído por debajo del 95 %, el nivel considerado necesario para prevenir la transmisión sostenida. EFE

data.title: Asesinan a repartidor frente a un centro de salud en Villa Adela, Comayagüela
data.description: Honduras.- Un joven repartidor, que se ganaba el sustento diario entregando pedidos a domicilio en la capital y otros sectores, fue asesinado a disparos la noche del martes 6 de octubre frente a un centro de salud situado en el barrio Villa Adela de Comayagüela. De acuerdo con el reporte preliminar, la víctima fue identificada como César David Martínez Maradiaga , quien se desempeñaba como " delivery ". Según testigos, el joven a era perseguida por hombres a bordo de una motocicleta, y que tras haberlo alcanzado comenzaron a dispararle en varias ocasiones hasta dejarlo muerto frente al centro asistencial Odilón Renderos. Producto de los impactos de arma de fuego, el cuerpo de Martínez Maradiaga quedó tendido en una acera peatona junto a su mochila de pedidos y su motocicleta encendida. Agentes de la Policía Nacional arribaron al lugar para acordonar la escena del crimen y recolectar indicios sobre el crimen . Miembros de Medicina Forense también se desplazaron a la zona para realizar el respectivo levantamiento y traslado del cadáver hacia la morgue capitalina. Hasta el momento, se desconoce el móvil del asesinato y la identidad de los hechores que huyeron con rumbo desconocido tras el hecho. Sin embargo, las autoridades mencionaron que abrieron una investigación en busca de esclarecer el caso. Se espera que durante las próximas horas brinden mayores detalles sobre el crimen que ha causado conmoción e indignación entre los ciudadanos durante las últimas horas. De momento, el cuerpo del joven quedó ingresado en la morgue; tras la autopsia será entregado a sus familiares dolientes. "Qué daño les hacía, solo era un delivery". "Pobre muchacho, todo por la delincuencia en este país". "Qué barbaridad, ya no se puede trabajar... y cómo se fue a meter a esa colonia, tito". data.translatedTitle: Asesinan a repartidor frente a un centro de salud en Villa Adela, Comayagüela
data.translatedDescription: Honduras.- Un joven repartidor, que se ganaba el sustento diario entregando pedidos a domicilio en la capital y otros sectores, fue asesinado a disparos la noche del martes 6 de octubre frente a un centro de salud situado en el barrio Villa Adela de Comayagüela. De acuerdo con el reporte preliminar, la víctima fue identificada como César David Martínez Maradiaga , quien se desempeñaba como " delivery ". Según testigos, el joven a era perseguida por hombres a bordo de una motocicleta, y que tras haberlo alcanzado comenzaron a dispararle en varias ocasiones hasta dejarlo muerto frente al centro asistencial Odilón Renderos. Producto de los impactos de arma de fuego, el cuerpo de Martínez Maradiaga quedó tendido en una acera peatona junto a su mochila de pedidos y su motocicleta encendida. Agentes de la Policía Nacional arribaron al lugar para acordonar la escena del crimen y recolectar indicios sobre el crimen . Miembros de Medicina Forense también se desplazaron a la zona para realizar el respectivo levantamiento y traslado del cadáver hacia la morgue capitalina. Hasta el momento, se desconoce el móvil del asesinato y la identidad de los hechores que huyeron con rumbo desconocido tras el hecho. Sin embargo, las autoridades mencionaron que abrieron una investigación en busca de esclarecer el caso. Se espera que durante las próximas horas brinden mayores detalles sobre el crimen que ha causado conmoción e indignación entre los ciudadanos durante las últimas horas. De momento, el cuerpo del joven quedó ingresado en la morgue; tras la autopsia será entregado a sus familiares dolientes. "Qué daño les hacía, solo era un delivery". "Pobre muchacho, todo por la delincuencia en este país". "Qué barbaridad, ya no se puede trabajar... y cómo se fue a meter a esa colonia, tito". "La violencia no para, que Dios tome el control de esos corazones que todavía piensan en hacer maldad", son los algunos de los diversos comentarios sobre este crimen.

data.title: Rusiška nafta Indijai tapo per brangi: kas nutiko
data.description: Iki Rusijos invazijos į Ukrainą Indija beveik nepirko „Urals“ rūšies naftos, tačiau karo metu ėmė sparčiai didinti jos importą. Tai lėmė nuolaidos ir Rusijos siekis rasti naujų pirkėjų savo žaliavai, kurios atsisakė Europos šalys. Galiausiai Indijos naftos perdirbimo gamyklos per parą pradėjo pirkti po 1–2 mln. barelių, o šių metų liepą dėl Artimųjų Rytų krizės pirkimai iš Rusijos šoktelėjo iki 2,44 mln. barelių per parą, sudarydami 56 proc. viso Indijos importo.

data.title: Flu monitoring season begins in Latvia
data.description: The 2026–2027 monitoring season for influenza and other acute respiratory infections has begun in Latvia, but so far, Latvia has only received the intranasal ‘Fluenz’ vaccine, which is intended for children who belong to specific health risk groups, according to the Disease Prevention and Control Centre (SPKC). This season, the production of influenza vaccines in Europe has been delayed; consequently, vaccine deliveries to Latvia are taking place gradually and slightly later than usual this year. Deliveries of the ‘Efluelda’ flu vaccine to GP practices will begin this week. This vaccine is intended for people aged 60 and over, as well as those with moderate or severe immunosuppression. Meanwhile, the “Vaxigrip” vaccine, which is intended for other target groups eligible for state-funded vaccination – including adults and children with chronic illnesses – is expected to arrive in Latvia by 13 November. This season, state-funded flu vaccination will be provided using three vaccines, each intended for different population groups. The first laboratory-confirmed cases of flu in Latvia this season were recorded even before the start of the flu monitoring season and were linked to travel outside Latvia. Meanwhile, in week 40 of 2026, when monitoring began, influenza was clinically diagnosed in three patients, or 3.9 cases per 100,000 population, which is lower than during the corresponding period of the previous season (9.9 cases per 100,000 population). A total of 918 patients, or an average of 1,179.3 per 100,000 population, consulted their GPs with symptoms of other acute respiratory infections. The prevalence of other acute respiratory infections is also slightly lower than during the corresponding period of the previous season.  Last week, influenza was not laboratory-confirmed in any of the 166 samples tested, whilst RSV infection was confirmed in one sample (0.6 per cent), according to laboratory surveillance data. The proportion of Covid-19-positive samples was 1.2 per cent, remaining at roughly the same level as the previous week. Unlike in previous years, no increase in Covid-19 cases was observed in late summer and early autumn this year.

data.title: Polish state-owned companies exploring business opportunities in Romania
data.description: Polish state-owned companies within the portfolio of the Industrial Development Agency (ARP) are showing growing interest in business opportunities and partnerships in the Romanian market, according to the Polish-Romanian Bilateral Chamber of Commerce and Industry. To facilitate direct contacts between Polish and Romanian companies, as well as dialogue with representatives of economic and government institutions and business organizations from both countries, the Chamber organized the Polish-Romanian Industrial Networking Reception. The event provided participants with an opportunity to present their business portfolios, operating models, and strategic priorities, as well as the areas in which they are seeking partnership opportunities with the local business community. In 2025, the Industrial Development Agency (ARP) recorded a turnover of EUR 136 million, while the participating companies reported revenues ranging from EUR 2.6 million to EUR 101 million: FPS H. Cegielski (EUR 101 million), Fabryka Kotłów SEFAKO (EUR 62.8 million), TF Silesia (EUR 24.3 million), GP Baltic (EUR 17 million), Opakomet (EUR 13 million), RAFAMET (EUR 11 million), Stomil Bydgoszcz (EUR 8.1 million), and PIAP Space (EUR 2.6 million). “We are here not only as a development institution, but also as a partner that brings together financing, restructuring, equity investments, and workforce-focused programmes. We want to fulfil this role together with our partners in Romania. Poland and Romania are two of the largest markets in the region, with similar ambitions in areas such as offshore energy, defence, semiconductors, and critical infrastructure. The partnership between our countries represents a direct investment in Europe’s production capabilities and jobs,” said Daniel Ryczek, CEO of ARP. As part of its efforts to strengthen trade and business relations between Romania and Poland, the Polish-Romanian Bilateral Chamber of Commerce and Industry also launched TwinMarkets.eu, a business platform designed to support connections between companies from the two countries. “Despite the current challenges, Romania remains a market with significant potential for Polish companies, both due to the size of its economy and the development opportunities available in strategic sectors. The complementarity of the two countries’ economies can create favorable conditions for investment, knowledge transfer, and joint projects with a long- term impact,” added Ovidiu Văleanu, Member of the Board of the Polish-Romanian Bilateral Chamber of Commerce and Industry. The platform provides users with a messaging service through which companies seeking partners, clients, or business development opportunities in the Romanian and Polish markets can interact directly.

data.title: First Otopeni MTB Adventure scheduled for November
data.description: The inaugural Otopeni MTB Adventure will take place on November 7, with races for children, families, amateur cyclists, and experienced competitors. The event will start and finish in 1 Mai-Odăile Park in Otopeni and will conclude the 2026 Riders Club season. The programme includes a 14 km short course beginning at 11:00. It is intended for children and participants new to competitive cycling, with separate female and male categories for ages 5-7, 8-10, and 11-13. Parents and other adults may accompany children in a special non-competitive category, the organisers said. The 37 km standard and electric mountain bike races will begin in waves at 12:30. The standard route is open to cyclists aged 14 and over, with categories ranging from amateur to elite, while separate women’s and men’s categories are available for e-bike riders. The routes will cross fields and wooded areas around Odăile, Tamași, Costeasca, Corbeanca, and Buftea, passing close to Mogoșoaia Palace. Online registration is open until November 5, with no on-site registration available. The first edition is limited to 1,000 participants. Otopeni residents can enter free of charge, while families registering at least three participants receive a 15% discount on the standard fee. Half of the event’s proceeds will be donated to the CLOVES Association to support children diagnosed with CLOVES syndrome, a rare congenital disorder. “We want Otopeni MTB Adventure to be more than the final race of the 2026 Riders Club season,” organiser Răzvan Jugănaru said. “We believe that every competition can leave something behind beyond the sporting results.” If weather conditions prevent the race from taking place safely on November 7, it will be rescheduled for November 21. Further details can be found here .

data.title: Romania’s sole nuclear power plant to remain shut down at least until mid-October
data.description: The two reactors of the Cernavoda Nuclear Power Plant, Romania's sole nuclear-power energy plant, will remain shut down at least until October 15, due to the low level of the Danube, according to an announcement made by state secretary in the Energy Ministry, Cristian Busoi, on Wednesday, October 7. “The period of low Danube flows and low water levels near Cernavoda is severely affecting the Nuclear Power Plant. We still have the two reactors shut down. The bad news is that, at least for the next 10 days, we have flows at historic lows. At least until October 15, we are unable to restart units 1 and 2 at Cernavoda,” he said, cited by G4Media . The low water levels are also affecting hydropower production, one of Romania’s main electricity sources. The authorities said that consumption restrictions will not be necessary, but warn that bills may increase due to the energy imports that Romania is forced to rely on. Back in early August, Romania’s nuclear group Nuclearelectrica (BVB: SNN) announced that it began procedures for the controlled shutdown of Unit 2 at the Cernavoda Nuclear Power Plant due to low Danube levels. Unit 1 had been shut down in July for the same reason. The two units together provide nearly 20% of the national electricity consumption from the grid and are the largest generating units in Romania, with 680 MW each. No date has been announced for restarting, as it all depends on the flow of the Danube.

data.title: National Geographic includes Romania in list of most beautiful holiday destinations for October
data.description: The prestigious National Geographic magazine included Romania in the top 6 of the most beautiful holiday destinations for October 2026 , along with New York, Madagascar, Argentina, Scotland and Egypt. The article by Lena-Marie Müller begins the entry on Romania by noting that “October is the last month in which the Transfăgărășan — a 56-mile highway that winds through the peaks and valleys of the southern Carpathian Mountains — is fully open to visitors.” “For those seeking full immersion into Romania’s more mystical history and culture, Transylvania is the ideal roaming ground. Follow in Count Dracula’s footsteps on a tour of the region’s famed Bran Castle — nicknamed Dracula's Castle due to its resemblance to the home of the fictional Transylvanian vampire —  before heading to nearby Brașov to see its gothic Black Church,” the article said. To eat like a local while on Transfagarasan or in Transylvania, National Geographic recommends kürtőskalács, or chimney cake, a “must-try delicacy that’s served year-round but best enjoyed on chilly autumn afternoons.” At the beginning of the year, the magazine placed Romania second in a global ranking of conservation projects worth traveling for due to its process of rewilding the Carpathians.

data.title: Pădurea Craiului becomes Romania’s seventh recognised ecotourism destination
data.description: Romania has officially recognised Pădurea Craiului (Craiului Forest) as an ecotourism destination, interim economy and tourism minister Irineu Darău announced. The area joins six other destinations that already hold the designation. The recognition will remain valid for three years and covers the localities of Măgești, Vadu Crișului, Șuncuiuș, Bratca, Bulz, Remeți, Căbești, and Roșia. According to Agerpres , Romania’s other recognised ecotourism destinations are Ținutul Zimbrului-Vânători-Neamț Natural Park in Neamț county, with a designation valid until 2028; Eco Maramureș-Mara-Cosău-Creasta Cocoșului in Maramureș county, valid until 2029; Țara Dornelor in Suceava county, valid until 2026; Țara Hațegului in Hunedoara county, valid until 2027; Vama Buzăului in Brașov county, valid until 2026; and Băile Tușnad and its surroundings in Harghita county, also valid until 2026. “This is not just a title. It is recognition of a model in which nature, heritage, local communities, and the economy must develop together,” Irineu Darău said after signing the document. The minister also stated that developing a tourism destination required more than natural attractions, pointing to the importance of management, infrastructure, services, and coordinated promotion. “Pădurea Craiului shows that a tourist destination is not built solely on the beauty of a place,” he said. “It is also built through administration, infrastructure, good services, and consistent promotion.” Minister Darău further added that the designation should create opportunities for local entrepreneurs and generate jobs and income within the participating communities. “This is the direction Romanian tourism must take: we should not limit ourselves to saying that we have beautiful places, but build competitive, recognisable, and responsible destinations around them,” he said. https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1755024513290451&set=a.297652522360998

According to Agerpres , Romania’s other recognised ecotourism destinations are Ținutul Zimbrului-Vânători-Neamț Natural Park in Neamț county, with a designation valid until 2028; Eco Maramureș-Mara-Cosău-Creasta Cocoșului in Maramureș county, valid until 2029; Țara Dornelor in Suceava county, valid until 2026; Țara Hațegului in Hunedoara county, valid until 2027; Vama Buzăului in Brașov county, valid until 2026; and Băile Tușnad and its surroundings in Harghita county, also valid until 2026. “This is not just a title. It is recognition of a model in which nature, heritage, local communities, and the economy must develop together,” Irineu Darău said after signing the document. The minister also stated that developing a tourism destination required more than natural attractions, pointing to the importance of management, infrastructure, services, and coordinated promotion. “Pădurea Craiului shows that a tourist destination is not built solely on the beauty of a place,” he said. “It is also built through administration, infrastructure, good services, and consistent promotion.” Minister Darău further added that the designation should create opportunities for local entrepreneurs and generate jobs and income within the participating communities. “This is the direction Romanian tourism must take: we should not limit ourselves to saying that we have beautiful places, but build competitive, recognisable, and responsible destinations around them,” he said. https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1755024513290451&set=a.297652522360998

data.title: BNP Paribas: Leadership appointments at Arval
data.description: As of 1 April 2027, Alain van Groenendael will become Chairman of Arval's Board of Directors. Annie Pin, who will join Arval on 26 October 2026 as Senior Advisor to the Chief Executive Officer, will be appointed Chief Executive Officer of Arval on 1 April 2027. Over the coming months, Alain van Groenendael and Annie Pin will work closely together, engaging with teams across Arval and Athlon, and preparing for Arval's next phase of growth. As CEO of Arval, Annie Pin will report to Thierry Laborde, Chief Operating Officer of BNP Paribas, in charge of Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS). "Alain has played a key role in strengthening Arval's position in the mobility sector. He brought teams together and drove the strategic initiatives that have enabled Arval to anticipate and embrace the profound changes reshaping mobility. With the recent acquisition of Athlon, Arval is starting a new chapter of its history, becoming the European co-leader in long-term vehicle leasing. I am delighted that Annie will bring more than 20 years of international leadership experience in mobility and financial services, an invaluable asset as we accelerate Arval's next phase of development." said Thierry Laborde, Chief Operating Officer of BNP Paribas, in charge of Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS). Annie Pin began her career in 2004 at Societe Generale's General Inspection before joining ALD Automotive, where she held several senior positions across the Nordic region, including Regional Risk Director and Managing Director for Norway. She subsequently became Group Chief Commercial Officer at Ayvens and a member of the Executive Committee, overseeing Commercial, Marketing and Communications, and First Line of Defence (LOD1) activities, leading a global organisation of more than 4,000 professionals across over 40 countries, while playing a key role in the transformation and integration of ALD and LeasePlan. Throughout her career, Annie has helped shape the transformation of the automotive and mobility industry, with a particular focus on the electrification of corporate fleets and the development of future mobility solutions. She is also a co-founder and board member of Inspiring Women in Fleet (IWIF), which promotes greater gender balance across the fleet industry. Annie holds a master's degree from Sciences Po Paris and an MBA from ESSEC Business School. Alain van Groenendael has been CEO of Arval since January 2019. Prior to that, he held various positions at BNP Paribas Personal Finance such as Board member and Deputy Chief Executive Officer from 2008 before becoming Chairman in 2015. In the same year, he joined the Management Committees of International Financial Services and Retail Banking at BNP Paribas Group. He played a key role in the international development of the group by forging strategic partnerships and driving digital transformation. He also served as President of Eurofinas, the European federation of credit associations, and Chairman of Opel Vauxhall Finance. He was also Vice-President of the ASF (French Association of Financial Companies) and a Board Member of the association "Les entreprises pour la Cite".

data.title: Bolt for Business appoints Romanian Bogdan Clipici as Regional Manager for 3 countries
data.description: Bogdan Clipici has been appointed Regional Manager for Bolt for Business, the branch of the well-known ridesharing app dedicated to work travel and employee meals. In the new position, he will coordinate the corporate-client division in Romania, Poland, and Ukraine. Clipici, aged 30, previously worked for Bolt for Business Romania, where he contributed to the doubling of the business locally. Overall, the number of active companies using Bolt for Business services increased to over 5,000 over the past two years. In his new role, the Romanian will coordinate the commercial development of corporate services across the three markets. “Poland is the market where we see the greatest potential in the region, and we plan to grow fivefold over the next three years. And in Ukraine, despite the current situation, we see growth opportunities, especially in the western part of the country, where there is somewhat greater stability,” said Bogdan Clipici, Regional Sales Manager, Bolt for Business, cited by Economedia . Bolt for Business provides transportation and mobility services for companies. Globally, the platform was used by more than 70,000 companies in December 2025. Last year, Bolt launched a new category in Bucharest called Little Bolt , offering passengers cheaper rides in compact electric vehicles. The company says the move supports its plan to reach net-zero carbon emissions by 2040.

data.title: Over 300,000 people expected at Romania’s largest religious pilgrimage
data.description: Hundreds of thousands of believers are expected over the course of a week at the Metropolitan Cathedral in Iasi, home of the remains of Saint Parascheva, the patron saint of the Moldova region. The pilgrimage began Thursday morning, October 8, when the relics of Saint Parascheva were taken out in procession and placed in the specially arranged area near the Metropolitan Cathedral. This year, alongside the relics of Saint Venerable Parascheva, the relics of Saint Venerable Paisius of Sihastria will also be available for veneration. The relics of the two saints will remain available for the faithful to venerate throughout the pilgrimage. According to estimates by the authorities and organizers, approximately 300,000 people are expected in Iasi between October 8 and 15. The largest influx is expected on October 13 and 14, when the waiting time could increase significantly. To manage the flow of people and avoid overcrowding, the authorities have established a single access corridor for pilgrims, which starts from the Metropolitan Cathedral and continues along Architect G.M. Cantacuzino, Iordache Lozonschi, Closca, Petru Movila, Uzinei, Morilor, Alexandru Ipsilanti Voda, Sfantul Andrei, Iancu Bacalu streets and King Ferdinand I of Romania Boulevard. Authorities recommend that pilgrims come prepared for long periods of waiting, have water and food, clothing appropriate for the weather conditions, and charged phones. Between October 8 and 15, information about the position of the end of the line is updated in real time, while law enforcement officers, volunteers, and Church representatives are present along the pilgrims’ route to provide assistance, according to G4Media . Saint Parascheva lived in the first half of the 11th century and was born at Epivata, nowadays Boiados in Bulgaria. The Saint’s relics were brought to Iasi in 1641, during the reign of the ruler Vasile Lupu. The canonization of Saint Parascheva the Venerable was decided by the members of the Holy Synod of the Romanian Orthodox Church in 1955. At that time, the date of her celebration was also established as October 14. The remains of the saint are famous for their alleged healing powers.

data.title: Bucharest secures EUR 87 mln to modernise public transport fleet, mayor says
data.description: Bucharest secured EUR 87.44 million in non-repayable funding from the Modernisation Fund to purchase new electric public transport vehicles, mayor Ciprian Ciucu announced. The European Investment Bank confirmed the project as a priority investment for the Romanian capital, while the City Hall will be required to cover only the value-added tax. The funding will finance ten new trams, 45 trolleybuses, and 40 electric buses. The bus order will comprise 20 vehicles measuring 12 metres and another 20 measuring 10 metres. “This is another major and important step towards more modern and cleaner public transport for our city,” Ciprian Ciucu said. The new trams will replace V3A and modernised V3A vehicles, while the trolleybuses will replace aging Astra Ikarus models. Meanwhile, the electric buses will take the place of Mercedes-Benz Citaro Euro 3 diesel buses currently used by Bucharest public transport operator STB. The project is intended to modernise the STB fleet and reduce transport-related pollution. “For the electric buses, the next essential step is to secure the charging infrastructure so that the new vehicles can be operated efficiently from their first day,” the mayor said. However, he did not announce a procurement timetable or expected delivery dates for the vehicles. https://www.facebook.com/ciprian.ciucu/posts/pfbid02YcHW2nkjqi1Fc2QkM1cktq7eAh27FQWsHNWBwj95nXHUDPwvucwvwg5VZYzW95Ual

data.title: ProCredit Bank moves Romanian headquarters to Business Garden Bucharest
data.description: ProCredit Bank has relocated its Romanian headquarters and more than 160 employees to Business Garden Bucharest after leasing 2,500 sqm in the office complex. The transaction, brokered by Colliers, increased the project’s occupancy rate to 90%. The bank also opened a 175 sqm round-the-clock self-service area on the ground floor of Building A. “Relocating our headquarters and more than 160 employees here reflects our commitment to operating sustainably, in a modern workplace that encourages collaboration and supports our long-term development,” said ProCredit Bank Romania CEO Ștefan Manole. Business Garden Bucharest has leased approximately 14,500 sqm of office space over the past 12 months and currently houses 35 companies. Located in the Orhideea-Grozăvești area of western-central Bucharest, the complex comprises three buildings with a combined 43,000 sqm of leasable space. Its tenants include Regina Maria, IKEA, Schindler, Tchibo, Vel Pitar, Rail Cargo, Sanamed, and Pandora. The surrounding office district has more than 629,000 sqm of modern stock, according to Vastint. Vastint Romania has operated locally since 2008 and owns Business Garden Bucharest and Timpuri Noi Square, with a combined leasable area of roughly 95,300 sqm. Its Romanian portfolio is expected to reach 155,000 sqm after the second phase of Timpuri Noi Square is completed. ProCredit Bank is part of Germany-based ProCredit Group and has operated in Romania for nearly 25 years, with a focus on financing small and medium-sized companies.

data.title: 120 MWh battery storage system enters operation in Romania’s Teiuș
data.description: A battery energy storage system (BESS) with a capacity of 120 MWh has entered operation in Teiuș, Alba county, project owner Eurowind Energy Romania and contractor Allview Energy announced. The facility has a power capacity of 60 MW and is connected to Eurowind Energy’s local photovoltaic park. The project was developed by Teiuș Solar, an affiliate of Danish renewable energy company Eurowind Energy, with financial support from Romania’s National Recovery and Resilience Plan. The total investment reached EUR 21 million. Allview Energy, the energy division of Romanian technology company Visual Fan, delivered the project under a full engineering, procurement, and construction contract. Its work covered design, procurement, construction, installation, technical integration, testing, and commissioning. “The photovoltaic park now has 120 MWh of storage capacity behind it, which takes in surplus energy and supplies it to the grid when it is really needed,” said Adrian Dobre, country manager of Eurowind Energy Romania. He added that storage could help balance the electricity system, reduce pressure on the grid during peak periods, and limit fluctuations in energy prices. In his turn, Lucian Peticilă, CEO of Visual Fan, said the project had progressed from design to fully operational infrastructure and would support greater flexibility and stability in Romania’s power grid. The Teiuș facility comes as Romania expands its renewable electricity capacity, increasing demand for batteries capable of managing differences between periods of generation and consumption. Eurowind Energy has operated in Romania since 2011 and currently runs four solar parks - Hălchiu, Măgurele, Pufești, and Teiuș - and the Pecineaga wind farm. The company reported 184 MW of operational capacity in Romania, including the 60 MW battery system at Teiuș, and a development pipeline of around 7.5 GW. Founded in Brașov in 2002, Visual Fan is listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange under the ticker ALW. Its Allview Energy division develops photovoltaic plants and battery storage projects.

data.title: Weekend calendar: Bucharest Photofest, Spotlight Light Art Fest, Animest, Bucharest Auto Show
data.description: In Bucharest: Animest Until October 11 More than 320 animated productions make up the program of the 21st edition of the event, a ten-day cinematic marathon for animation fans of all ages. More on the program here . Bucharest Photofest October 9 – October 18 The festival presents around 50 events across more than ten venues in Bucharest, with over 200 exhibiting artists. The program covers exhibitions, film screenings, a conference, analogue photography, a photobook fair, educational events and concerts. More details here . Spotlight – International Light Art Festival October 9 – October 11 This year’s edition takes place under the theme Playground and gathers 19 immersive installations and various video mapping shows. More here . Open Streets Until October 11 For 25 weekends, the capital’s central area hosts various concerts, shows, parades, workshops for children, sports activities, and guided tours. Calea Victoriei becomes pedestrian again, and, as a novelty this year, the route is extended to Ion Brezoianu Street, which is included in the program for the first time. More info here . Art Safari Until December 20 The new season presents an exhibition about Brâncuși and the muses that influenced his creation, one about the Pop Art movement; photographs by Cristian Mungiu; as well as a series of other temporary exhibitions. More details here . Wild Metaphysics Until October 24 The exhibition, open at Gaep, features six Brazilian artists whose works explore the extraordinary, the oneiric, and the metaphysical. The artists, whose work is presented in Romania for the first time, are Thiago Barbalho, Maria Nepomuceno, Mariana Rocha, Guga Szabzon, Marina Woisky, Michel Zózimo. More here . Bucharest Auto Show Until October 11 Held at Romexpo, the event gathers concept models, national premieres and the latest innovations for the 2026–2027 season. More details here . In the country: Picasso en visite Until January 17, 2027 The exhibition, presented by Art Encounters in Timișoara in partnership with Musée Picasso Antibes, brings together 69 works by Pablo Picasso, namely paintings, drawings, engravings, lithographs and ceramics, presented for the first time to the Romanian public. More here . BETA – Timișoara Architecture Biennial Until October 25 The event takes place under the theme “In Practice – as opposed to ‘in theory’” and will see more than 40 projects by participants from 15 countries transform the building of the former Ion Mincu High School. More here .

data.title: Sass' Signature Wine Dinners: An Evening with Antinori
data.description: This October, Sass' Restaurant & Lounge at Corinthia Bucharest introduces Sass' Signature Wine Dinners, a new series built around remarkable estates, considered pairings and evenings designed to unfold at their own pace. The first edition is dedicated to Antinori, one of Italy's most iconic wine names. On Wednesday, 14 October, from 19:30, guests are invited into the intimate setting of Sass' Speakeasy for a five-course menu created around a curated Antinori journey. The evening opens with Tenuta Montenisa Cuvee Royale Brut NV, Franciacorta DOCG. Salmon Gravlax is paired with Tenuta Guado al Tasso Vermentino 2025, followed by Roasted Turbot with Castello della Sala Cervaro della Sala 2024, Paccheri Porcini with Pian delle Vigne Brunello di Montalcino 2021, and Lamb Striploin with Tenuta Tignanello Tignanello 2023. Lemon Tart and Amaro Montenegro bring the dinner to a close. Throughout the evening, a Vinimondo and Antinori representative will guide guests through the wines, the estates and the thinking behind each pairing, turning dinner into a conversation about place, character and the details that make a wine memorable. Conceived as the beginning of a recurring series, Sass' Signature Wine Dinners brings together wine, gastronomy and the distinctive atmosphere of Sass' in a more intimate format, one where the pace is slower, the table is part of the story and every pairing has room to be discovered. Event details Wednesday, 14 October 2026, 19:30 Sass' Speakeasy, Sass' Restaurant & Lounge, Corinthia Bucharest 21 Regina Elisabeta Boulevard, Bucharest, 030167, Romania 700 RON per person, five-course menu and wine pairing included Reservations: https://sevn.ly/x1W1LN9v

data.title: Romania’s Constitutional Court rejects government challenge over EUR 1 bln magistrates’ wage claims
data.description: The arrears stem from salary increases granted to some magistrates through court decisions. The Constitutional Court’s ruling means that the underlying litigation, involving more than EUR 1 billion, will continue before the courts. On May 5, the Bucharest Court of Appeal admitted the ICCJ’s request to oblige the government to pay the amounts. The government and the Ministry of Finance appealed the ruling before the High Court, which has postponed a decision several times. The next hearing is scheduled for Thursday, October 8, according to Cursdeguvernare.ro .

data.title: Romania signs EUR 757 mln contract for 12 Airbus H225M helicopters
data.description: The agreement was concluded with the French Directorate General for Armaments (DGA) under the European Commission's Security Action for Europe (SAFE) initiative. "We are honoured that Romania has chosen the H225M to strengthen its defence capabilities. This selection will also bolster Romania’s industrial capabilities through our long-term partnership with IAR, Romania’s sole helicopter manufacturer,” said Matthieu Louvot, CEO of Airbus Helicopters. This is the second contract signed by Romania with Airbus Helicopters under the SAFE initiative, following a recent order for seven H160 and five H145 helicopters intended for public-service missions. In July, interim defence minister Radu Miruță announced the planned acquisition of the 12 H225M helicopters together with 12 Thales radars, Economica.net reported. He said at the time that the helicopters would interact with the IAR Ghimbav platform for localisation. According to a July release from the Ministry of National Defence, the EUR 757 mln value includes the 12 helicopters, an initial logistics support package and personnel training. The  H225M has proven its reliability and durability in combat conditions and crisis areas around the world, Airbus said, adding that there are more than 350 H225s and H225Ms in service, totalling more than one million flight hours. The twelve H225M customers include Brazil, France, Hungary,  Indonesia, Iraq, Kuwait, Malaysia, Mexico, Morocco, the Netherlands, Singapore, and Thailand.

data.title: Romanian PM-designate Luca Niculescu meets major parties before sketching ruling strategy
data.description: Luca Niculescu plans to sketch out his governing strategy and the composition of the cabinet only after the consultations, Economica.net reported. Niculescu faces the difficult task of finding common ground between radically different economic visions: the Social Democrats favour wage-led growth with limited, if any, streamlining of the state sector, while the centre-right PNL and USR advocate reforms of public administration and state-owned enterprises to create fiscal space and improve public services. The appointment of political ministers explicitly backed by the parties could complicate efforts to secure support from most centrist parties. A technocratic government, with experts implicitly backed by the political parties, therefore appears the more likely option at this stage. The meetings announced by Niculescu will take place at the parties' headquarters, with the schedule for consultations with the other parliamentary parties to be communicated as soon as possible. “I will publicly present the outcome of these discussions,” Niculescu said. In his second Facebook post since being designated prime minister on October 5, Niculescu said that his main concerns include economic growth, protecting purchasing power and measures to support the recovery of the business environment. The PSD leadership received a mandate from its National Permanent Bureau on October 6 to begin discussions with Niculescu. Meanwhile, the party appears to have shifted its position from seeking direct control over a majority of ministries to supporting the appointment of technocrats – experts without explicit party membership who would be prepared to implement Social Democrat policies while shielding the party from the political costs of the expected economic hardship. The Social Democrats are conditioning their support for a Niculescu cabinet on two potentially conflicting requirements: respecting the fiscal trajectory established under the Excessive Deficit Procedure while resuming growth-stimulating policies, in contrast with the policies pursued by former prime minister Ilie Bolojan, which PSD has condemned as unnecessary austerity. PNL will decide whether to support a government led by Niculescu in the parliamentary investiture vote after analysing his proposals for ministerial positions, MP Ionel Bogdan, the party's spokesperson, said on Tuesday. He reaffirmed that the Liberals will not form a government together with PSD. USR will analyse the programme, the ministerial team and the parliamentary majority supporting Niculescu's bid for prime minister, party president Dominic Fritz said. He also reiterated that USR will not support a government containing PSD ministers or one “controlled” by PSD.

data.title: CEC Bank finances EUR 45 mln edible oil plant in central Romania
data.description: CEC Bank is the project's main banking partner, providing the necessary bank financing alongside European funds and contributions from the cooperative's members. The new facility will have a processing capacity of 600 tonnes of oilseeds per day and is designed to become one of the most modern and efficient oil processing units in the region. The plant will cover 8.5 hectares and include six silos for raw-material storage, meal-storage facilities and tanks. The project also includes a 1.65 MW agrovoltaic installation equipped with energy-storage systems, aimed at reducing operating costs and the facility's carbon footprint. “Access to financing for high-value-added projects for Romanian farmers remains a strategic priority for CEC Bank. Supporting investments in processing capacities is an essential component for balancing the trade balance in the agri-food sector,” said Adrian Mușat, director of CEC Bank's Large Companies Department. “The Podișul Transilvaniei project demonstrates that Romanian agriculture can take the step from simply exporting raw materials to high-performance finished products, when there is entrepreneurial vision, association in cooperatives and a solid financial partnership,” he added. The Podișul Transilvaniei Agricultural Cooperative brings together 21 farmers from Cluj, Alba and Mureș counties. The project's financing combines European funds, contributions from cooperative members and a bank loan from CEC Bank.

data.title: Altex Romania opens first rebranded Brico DIY store
data.description: Altex agreed to acquire Kingfisher’s 31-store Brico Depot chain in Romania for EUR 70 mln in December 2024. The transaction was completed in 2025, with Brico becoming part of the Altex group alongside the Altex and Media Galaxy brands. The company opened the two stores on September 8 within the same commercial project in Vaslui, northeastern Romania, according to a company press release cited by Economica.net . The new Brico store was built from scratch and is the first to feature the brand’s new concept and visual identity. The Brico and Altex stores have separate spaces and entrances but share a parking area. “Through this project, we are bringing Altex and Brico together for the first time, in a single home destination, in Vaslui. Customers will find here, in one place, everything they need for their projects – from construction materials and solutions for home and garden design, to home appliances and technology. We want to be with them throughout their projects, from inspiration and consultancy to choosing the right solutions,” said Raul Filip, deputy general manager of Altex Romania. “At the same time, Vaslui marks an important moment for our development: it is the first Brico store built from scratch and the first to bring the brand’s new concept, a landmark for the stores we will develop in the future,” he added. Brico has been part of Altex Romania since October 2025, alongside the Altex and Media Galaxy brands. The three brands have distinct positioning and strategies, while benefiting from the group’s experience and infrastructure in retail, e-commerce, logistics, services and financing. Altex Romania is the largest electro-IT retailer in Romania, operating the Altex, Media Galaxy and Brico brands. The group has more than 165 stores nationwide across the three brands and operates an online platform under an omnichannel model.

data.title: AEI estimates electricity price for one-year contracts may rise 22% in Romania
data.description: The estimated increase ranges from RON 0.25 to RON 0.50 per kWh, as reported by Ziarul Financiar . The association revised its estimates made in August 2026 following the extension of the electricity market alert situation well beyond initial expectations, as well as changes in its forecasts for gas prices and the exchange rate. Data from market operator OPCOM confirmed the sharp increase in wholesale electricity prices. In August, the average day-ahead market (DAM) price rose to RON 793.19 per MWh, from RON 409.45 per MWh a year earlier. In September, the average price increased to RON 917.36 per MWh, from RON 506.05 per MWh in September 2025.

data.title: Romania expected to keep monetary policy rate at 6.5%
data.description: The central bank may nevertheless provide some insight into its exchange-rate policy after the leu lost around 2% since July amid a more flexible managed-floating exchange-rate regime and a decline in foreign-exchange reserves. Comments by central bank spokesmen following the sharp depreciation episode in early October suggested a change in the BNR’s reaction function, with greater weight being given to interest-rate stability than to exchange-rate stability, an Erste Group note on the monetary policy decision said. The central bank has broadly reiterated that there has been no change in the managed-floating FX regime, but that FX management has become less tight. This echoes comments by BNR governor Mugur Isărescu in August that the central bank has room for greater exchange-rate flexibility. The outlook for EUR/RON, however, remains conditional on fiscal consolidation and political stability. On the other hand, despite expected rate moves by major central banks, rate hikes in Romania appear unlikely given an economy operating with a deeply negative output gap. The BNR’s press release is unlikely to provide many additional insights into its thinking, except for potentially signalling an upward revision to the short-term inflation profile in the next Inflation Report, due after the November 12 monetary policy meeting, Erste Research said in a note. Erste Group currently forecasts inflation at 6.4% y/y at the end of this year, although the recent leu depreciation and changes in commodity prices are tilting the risk balance upwards. This is likely to result in a forecast revision to around 6.9% y/y, unless September CPI data bring significant surprises compared with its forecast of 6.6% y/y, the group said. A disinflationary trajectory next year, provided the fiscal stance remains firm – itself contingent on political stability – should allow the BNR to start easing monetary policy. Isărescu said at the August press conference that the central bank would start considering rate cuts once inflation falls below the key interest rate, which could happen at the beginning of next year.

data.title: Romanian employees increasingly turn to AI for help at work, report says
data.description: Tools based on artificial intelligence are becoming the go-to problem-solvers for employees whenever a problem arises, according to the MKOR study “AI Adoption Report Romania 2026.” Roughly 1 in 5 employees (22%) ask an AI first, rather than a team colleague or direct manager. When they do not know how to solve a work task, employees in Romania most often turn to an AI assistant (22%). This is followed by the organization’s internal resources (19%), then a colleague at a similar level, the direct manager, and an internet search, all three at 16%. Only 9% try to solve the task themselves, through trial and error. However, the difference between AI and the other options is still not very large. The six options range between 9% and 22%, indicating that Romanian employees still divide their instinct to ask for help among several sources, not just between human and machine. For 4 in 10 employees who use AI at work, it is primarily a practical tool. 39% use it to get rid of repetitive and boring tasks, while 39% perceive it as an advantage over other professionals in their field. Another 31% consider it a necessity, so as not to fall behind. Only 6% feel AI as additional pressure and 4% as a source of stress or anxiety. Employees tie in their use of AI into a larger picture as well. More than half (58%) do not anticipate major changes over the next 3-5 years: 32% believe their work will not be affected at all, while 26% believe AI will take over only minor tasks. On the other hand, 23% expect a significant part of their responsibilities to change, while 11% believe their role could become rare or disappear. Overall, the average level of concern is 4.0 on a scale from 1 to 7. More than a quarter of employees (28%) report a high level of concern, with scores of 6 or 7. The study shows a link between the use of AI and expectations regarding one’s own role. Those who already use AI anticipate changes more often: among all respondents who work, 38% of AI users expect their work to change moderately or significantly, compared with 21% of those who have not used it. “AI adoption in companies in Romania starts from the bottom, from employee initiative. People have started using these tools because they help them work faster and find solutions more easily, often without waiting for official approval,” said Cori Cimpoca, Founder of MKOR. The main risk highlighted by the study concerns the increasingly small number of entry-level positions. Eliminating these positions today may create a shortage in the medium and long term of workers capable of solving complex problems, which only practical experience can compensate for. To adapt to workplaces that integrate AI, employees noted that critical thinking and the ability to verify work done by AI (21%), adaptability and continuous learning (20%), specialization in practical fields (19%), and effective use of AI tools (15%) are important.

data.title: Romanian prosecutors seize Călin Georgescu’s bank accounts in fraud case
data.description: Prosecutors with the Directorate for Investigating Organized Crime and Terrorism (DIICOT) announced on Wednesday, October 7, that they had seized several bank accounts opened in Călin Georgescu’s name. It is not yet clear how many bank accounts were seized, but Digi24 sources referred to seven accounts holding roughly EUR 100,000. Georgescu, 64, is being investigated for setting up an organized criminal group and fraud with particularly serious consequences, in continued form. The damage in the case in which he was placed in preventive custody for 30 days amounts to EUR 1.1 million. The same day, prosecutors continued searching through Georgescu’s electronic devices. The wife of the former presidential candidate, Cristela Georgescu, also arrived at DIICOT headquarters for the second consecutive day. During the first day, she complained about “the brutal way in which the house was entered,” as well as the way her father was treated by investigators. In addition, she spoke about “the humiliating and traumatizing way in which Călin was handcuffed, taken from traffic, without him posing a danger.” She added that the case represents political persecution. On Monday, October 5, Georgescu’s father-in-law, Vasile Moldoveanu, also arrived at the DIICOT center to be questioned as a witness in the fraud case. Meanwhile, several hundred of Georgescu’s supporters have been camped out before the Central Arrest in Bucharest since September 29, when he was taken into custody. According to investigators, in September 2021, Georgescu, businessman Ionel Rusen and an Italian citizen formed an organized criminal group that acted in a coordinated manner mainly in Romania, but also in the United Kingdom “for the purpose of obtaining unjust patrimonial benefits.” The evidence gathered so far showed that starting in September 2021, during meetings organized in Bucharest and Argeș County, and subsequently in the United Kingdom, the members of the organized criminal group misled an injured party into believing that they could obtain EUR 6 million in financing by concluding a loan agreement with a banking institution, subject to the provision of collateral. Under these circumstances, the perpetrators caused the victim to transfer more than EUR 1 million. Subsequently, under the pretext that the loan could be increased to EUR 15 million, provided that additional collateral was deposited, they caused the victim to transfer another amount, EUR 100,000. The injured party suffered total damages of more than EUR 1.1 million. Călin Georgescu is also being investigated in two other criminal cases concerning attempted coup and legionary propaganda. Cǎlin Georgescu was the surprise first-place finisher in the first round of Romania’s 2024 presidential election, which was annulled by the Constitutional Court .

data.title: Bucharest Photofest to bring over 200 artists to Romanian capital
data.description: Bucharest Photofest returns from October 9 to 18 with more than 200 artists and 40 events across ten venues in the Romanian capital. This year’s theme, “Witness,” explores photography as a form of social and cultural engagement. The programme includes work documenting the siege of Mariupol by Ukrainian photographer Evgeniy Maloletka, the human experience of war and crisis by Iranian artist Toulo Adl Parvar, and displacement through the lens of Bosnia and Herzegovina’s Vedad Divović. The festival opens at Point on October 9 with Witness: Images That Refuse to Forget , a collective exhibition featuring photographers commissioned by the UN Refugee Agency, UNHCR. The opening night will also include a screening of Minamata , starring Johnny Depp as American photojournalist W. Eugene Smith. Photography-related films will continue at Cinema Union on October 16 and 17. The selection includes Ernest Cole: Lost and Found , An Underground Bird , Finding the Landscape , Forgetting , KIN, and In Passing , followed by a discussion with Lithuanian director Gailė Garnelytė. Kulturhaus will serve as the festival’s central venue, hosting seven exhibitions and artist-led tours. These include Adl Parvar’s Displacement (Ghorbat) , Joakim Kocjancic’s SOLVARV , Chiara Ernandes’ Still Birth , Divović’s Home of the Perpetually Lost , Sigurður Ólafur Sigurðsson’s Reykjanes Awakens, and Maloletka’s Witnessing the War . data.title: Cushman & Wakefield Echinox: Real estate becomes Romania’s second-largest destination for foreign capital
data.description: Real estate transactions accounted for 16.4% of Romania’s total foreign direct investment stock at the end of 2025, up from 16% a year earlier, according to National Bank of Romania data analysed by Cushman & Wakefield Echinox. The sector ranked second behind manufacturing, which held EUR 35.7 billion in foreign capital, equivalent to 26.5% of the national total. Real estate transactions attracted net FDI inflows of EUR 479 million during 2025, down from EUR 593 million in the previous year. The construction sector separately recorded EUR 74 million in net foreign investment inflows, taking its total FDI stock to EUR 1.82 billion. Combined, construction and real estate transactions held almost EUR 23.9 billion in foreign capital at the end of 2025. Their stock increased by approximately EUR 15.5 billion, or 185.7%, from EUR 8.4 billion in 2015, while their share of Romania’s total FDI rose by 4.8 percentage points. “Annual inflows may vary depending on the economic environment and investment cycles, but the consistent growth of the FDI stock indicates the continued accumulation of foreign capital in the sector,” said Claudia Scarlat, deputy head of valuation and consulting at Cushman & Wakefield Echinox. Romania attracted EUR 7.9 billion in net FDI inflows across all sectors in 2025, an increase of 41.1% from the previous year and the third-highest annual level recorded during the past decade. Equity investment more than doubled to EUR 3.25 billion, while reinvested earnings reached EUR 3.01 billion and debt instruments accounted for EUR 1.65 billion. The country’s total net FDI stock rose by 7.8% to EUR 134.8 billion at the end of 2025. It has more than doubled from EUR 64.7 billion in 2015. Foreign capital remained heavily concentrated in Bucharest and the surrounding Ilfov county, which accounted for 66.9% of Romania’s FDI stock, up from 65.4% in 2024. The region also contains almost 63% of the country’s modern office, retail, industrial and logistics property stock.

data.title: Romania-Moldova power line to be named Trump Liberty Line
data.description: A high-voltage power line that will connect Romania and the Republic of Moldova is set to bear the name of United States president Donald Trump, the US embassy in Chisinau ‌said on Monday, October 5. The Strășeni-Gutinaș power line, backed by a USD 130 million US ⁠government investment, would strengthen Moldova's energy security ​and independence, according to the same source. The route of the line, with an estimated length of approximately 70 km on the territory of the Republic of Moldova, will cross 25 localities in the districts of Strășeni, Călărași, Nisporeni and Hîncești. "The government of the Republic of Moldova ​supports initiatives that benefit the citizens of the Republic of Moldova, especially those that ensure the country's security ​and energy infrastructure," government spokesperson Dumitru Ciorici told ​ Reuters . The new line is important for the Republic of Moldova, which meets most of its electricity needs through imports, including through existing connections with Romania and Ukraine. However, Ukraine’s energy infrastructure has been repeatedly affected by Russian attacks, which have created risks in the past for the Republic of Moldova’s energy supply. By strengthening its connection with Romania, the Republic of Moldova can better diversify and secure its electricity sources and reduce its vulnerability to potential supply disruptions in the region, according to the government in Chisinau. According to Reuters, foreign governments have begun associating Trump’s name with such projects amid efforts to win the support of the US president. In Romania, Daniel Băluță, the Social Democratic (PSD) mayor of Bucharest’s District 4, championed the "Donald Trump" Romanian-American Friendship Park to mark  250 years since the US Declaration of Independence.

Yandex is one of Russia’s largest technology companies and the country’s dominant search engine, offering services including cloud computing, online storage, email, maps and ride-hailing. Ukraine also struck a major oil refinery in Bashkortostan.

data.title: Ukraine Opens Gas Exports for Private Producers for First Time Since 2022
data.description: The Cabinet of Ministers on Oct. 7 approved partial exports of domestically produced gas, letting private producers sell up to 15% of the previous month's output abroad through exchange auctions. The decision follows a gas surplus in the commercial segment, a wide gap between Ukrainian and European prices, and storage levels above the government's target.

data.title: Lithuania Approves €15M ($16.8M) for Ukraine’s Recovery and Reconstruction Through World Bank, EIB
data.description: Lithuania approved €15 million ($16.8 million) for Ukraine’s recovery, allocating €10 million ($11.2 million) through the World Bank’s SPUR 2.0 program and €5 million ($5.6 million) through the EIB’s EU4U Fund. data.title: New Russian Drone Wave Targets Kyiv and Western Ukraine After Deadly Strikes on Putin’s Birthday

data.title: Russian Opposition Condemns EU Decision to Lift Usmanov Sanctions Without Freeing Political Prisoners
data.description: Russian opposition figures criticized France for securing the removal of Kremlin-linked billionaire Alisher Usmanov from EU sanctions in connection with the release of a French prisoner in Azerbaijan. They warned that the decision weakened Europe’s sanctions policy and failed to secure the release of Russian political prisoners. The deal also drew criticism in Azerbaijan.

data.title: Russian Attacks on Kyiv Kill at Least 4 as Rescuers Find Two More Bodies in Drone-Hit High-Rise
data.description: Russian attacks on Kyiv on Oct. 7 killed at least four people during the evening strikes, after rescuers discovered two bodies in a damaged high-rise in Desnianskyi district early Thursday. Four people, including two children, were injured there, while 22 residents were rescued. Two additional deaths were reported from a separate attack earlier Wednesday.

data.title: Kazakhstan Says Talks Underway to Bring Russia’s Kazakh Fighters Home
data.description: Kazakhstan is negotiating with Moscow to return citizens serving with Russian forces in Ukraine after men and their relatives said they had been deceived or coerced into signing military contracts. data.title: Putin’s Birthday Strikes Kill at Least 32 Ukrainians, Including 5 Children, as More Bodies Found in Kyiv
data.description: Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine on Oct. 7 killed at least 32 people, including five children. The death toll in Pryluky rose to 22, while two more bodies were recovered from a Kyiv apartment building early Thursday. Zelensky condemned the strikes, which coincided with Putin’s 74th birthday, and called for stronger international pressure on Moscow.

data.title: Russia’s Donbas Advance Goes Into Reverse as Ukraine Retakes Ground
data.description: Ukraine’s counteroffensive in northern Donetsk has disrupted Russia’s attempt to encircle the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk defensive belt and reversed months of Russian gains, The New York Times reported. data.title: Kyiv’s AI Turrets Provide ‘Last-Level’ Protection, Defense Advisor Says

data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. Ganhar o congresso não importa em que circunstância e ter novamente o partido na mão, é uma fase concluída em proveito deles, enquanto verdadeiros militantes do PAIGC estão a bater palmas. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio. Documento António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13

Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio. data.title: Fonasa sin “déficit”
data.description: El Fonasa no debería ser evaluado solo por la brecha anual entre ingresos y egresos. La verdadera cuestión es cómo financiar de manera sostenible el gasto que requiere un seguro nacional de salud. Desde hace años, cada vez que se conocen los resultados financieros del Fondo Nacional de Salud (Fonasa) reaparece en la prensa la afirmación de que el Fondo es “deficitario”.
